info.title: Strategic Investigation Platform
info.description: Autonomous research. Governed reasoning. Human decisions.

schema.title: Response List Investigations Api Investigations Get
Response Documents Api Investigations  Investigation Id  Documents Get

get.description: Privacy scan inspection: sanitised text and scan summary. Raw content is never served.
Most recent events first. ``limit`` is capped at 2000; ``audit_count`` on the detail gives the total.

schema.title: Response Audit Trail Api Investigations  Investigation Id  Audit Get
Response Collection Api Investigations  Investigation Id   Collection  Get

AnalysisRequest.title: AnalysisRequest
AnalysisRequest.description: A request for a deterministic analytical operation (see ``sip.tools.analytics``).

ClaimChain.title: ClaimChain
ClaimChain.description: Option -> finding -> claim -> evidence -> source, for one claim.

ConfidenceBand.title: ConfidenceBand
ConfidenceBand.description: Ordinal band, NOT a probability. See docs/evaluation.md#confidence.

DocumentOut.title: DocumentOut
DocumentOut.description: Privacy-scan inspection view: sanitised text and scan summary only.

EvidenceNeed.title: EvidenceNeed
EvidenceNeed.description: What the evidence is being used to establish. Source quality is judged relative to this.

Finding.title: Finding
Finding.description: A conclusion sufficiently supported under defined criteria (see ``promotion_criteria``).

InvestigationFrame.title: InvestigationFrame
InvestigationFrame.description: The Investigation Lead's output. It frames the problem; it does not try to answer it.

ItemDecision.title: ItemDecision
ItemDecision.description: Per-item response inside a batch review (e.g. one document in a privacy review).

Level.title: Level
Level.description: Generic ordinal scale used for priority, relevance, value of information, etc.

PrivacyScanSummary.title: PrivacyScanSummary
PrivacyScanSummary.description: What a reviewer (and the agent boundary) may know about a scan: counts and categories only.

ReviewResponseIn.title: ReviewResponseIn
ReviewResponseIn.description: The responding actor is deliberately absent: it is taken from the authenticated principal.

Role.title: Role
Role.description: RBAC roles. Mapped from Entra ID app roles in deployed environments.

RoutingDecision.title: RoutingDecision
RoutingDecision.description: Why the graph looped or stopped after a challenge round. Persisted for audit and UI.

SourceType.title: SourceType
SourceType.description:
What kind of publisher/artefact a source is. Authority is *not* stored here: it depends on
what the evidence is being used for (see ``sip.evidence.source_quality``).

Usage.title: Usage
Usage.description: Accumulated resource usage. Summed by a LangGraph reducer across parallel branches.
